CustomField.description: Actual Hours times the Hourly Rate; with Use rate cards on, the sum of each counted time entry's amount (Time Amount). Kept by ProjectCostHandler on every project save, which a counted time entry's save causes through the roll-up summaries, and by ProjectCostSync after Use rate cards changes. Blank when rate cards are off and the project has no Hourly Rate.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Actual Hours times the Hourly Rate; with rate cards on, the hours times the rate each entry was logged at.
CustomField.label: Actual Cost
